part.text:
Implemented the ACL reset correction in `src/acl.c`.

`ACL SETUSER <user> reset` now clears both `sanitize-payload` and `skip-sanitize-payload` flags, restoring the same sanitization state as a newly created user instead of implicitly enabling payload sanitization.

Validation:
- `make -j2` completed successfully in the provided container.
- `./runtest --single unit/acl-v2` passed.
- `./runtest --single unit/acl` ran the new reset regression successfully, but has one pre-existing assertion expecting the old `sanitize-payload` behavior, so it now fails by design.
- `git diff --check` passed.
